title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E44 — Beat the Unbeaten: Back for Revenge
Competitor turned Judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge, but soon that could all change; two of the smiths who faced Ben in his very first competition are back to seek their revenge in a single 5-hour showdown.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
Championship Supersized Weapons
"Forged in Fire" Judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top supersized weapons to come out of the forge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
Championship Throwing Weapons
Judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top throwing weapons to come out of the forge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E41 — Beat the Unbeaten: Round One
Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths compete in a single 5-hour round; their blades will be put through an intense round of testing, and only one will earn the opportunity to face off against Ben Abbott.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E43 — Beat the Unbeaten: Broken Blade Revenge
Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths who suffered broken blades hope to rewrite history in a 5-hour round; their blades will be tested, and one of them will get the chance to face off against Ben Abbott.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E45 — Beat the Unbeaten: The Final Showdown
Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott still remains undefeated in the forge with a record of 8-0, but two smiths handpicked by Doug and Dave want to change that; after a tough five-hour forging round, their weapons must survive a round of testing.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E42 — Beat the Unbeaten: Scrap Steel Challenge
Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths compete in a 5-hour round during which they make blades out of scrap steel; these blades will be tested, with one smith getting the chance to take on Ben.

title: The Warfighters
description:
S01 E05 — Ambush of April 7th
On April 7, 2004, a group of U.S. Marines got ambushed near Fallujah, Iraq; together, the Marines fight on, making 1st Reconnaissance Battalion, Bravo Company, 2nd Platoon one of the most decorated platoons for heroism in the War on Terror.

title: The Warfighters
description:
S01 E11 — Objective Berlin
A platoon loses both 19-year-old Pfc. Eric Hario and seasoned Staff Sgt. Jason Dahlke on a battle damage assessment mission in Afghanistan; life will never be the same for the Army Rangers or for Eric and Jason's family members back home.

title: The Warfighters
description:
S01 E06 — A Warrior's Battle: The Story of Rob Guzzo
Navy SEAL Rob Guzzo's platoon deploys to Iraq in 2006 and faces an evil enemy and combat so intense, it leaves Guzzo with post-traumatic stress disorder.

title: The Warfighters
description:
S01 E12 — A Soldier's Best Friend
U.S. Army Ranger Trent McDonald becomes renowned for his dog whispering skills; McDonald loses his best friend and military service dog, Benno, on a night raid in Afghanistan in 2012, then his new dog, Layka, gets shot weeks later while saving lives.

title: A Complete History of the Green Berets
description: Tracing the roots of the Green Berets, who were chosen based on intelligence, physical strength and the ability to speak foreign languages.
